'''Shock troopers''' were a special type of military personnel used by various [[organization]]s throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They usually served as [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] or [[elite]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] reserved for operations requiring speed and skill. Some shock [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], such as those commanded by the [[Togorian/Legends|Togorian]] [[Kr'saang]], acted as [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]].

[[Clone shock trooper/Legends|Clone shock troopers]] were elite [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They were led by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commanders]] [[Fox/Legends|Fox]], [[Thorn/Legends|Thorn]], and later [[Thire/Legends|Thire]] by the end of the war. As members of the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]], a military police [[unit]] stationed in the [[Coruscant/Legends|capital world]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] shock troopers had the authority to conduct random inspections on civilians in order to discover and detain [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Spy/Legends|spies]] or sympathizers.

The shock troopers fought alongside the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and other [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], in which they ultimately repelled the Separatist invaders from the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. Their services were retained by the Republic's successor state, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], under the reign of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], where they served as [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Imperial stormtroopers]] of the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]]. Though the Coruscant Guard remained composed of shock troopers, it was no longer exclusively composed of clones. Under the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], enlisted [[Human/Legends|Humans]] were recruited into the Guard's ranks and trained as [[Imperial shock trooper/Legends|Imperial shock troopers]].
